summary: Phase 4 continuation testing complete. Backend AI chat (Claude Sonnet 4.6 SSE) + regression: 17/17 pytest passed (4 new AI + 13 regression). Frontend: FloatingActions widget shows all 7 buttons after toggle, AI chat panel opens via fab-ai-chat, custom message streams response (~107 chars) with finance content, ai-chat-close works, navbar landscape logo loads from customer-assets.emergentagent.com (h=56 desktop, h=48 mobile), Calculator SIP ₹10000/15Y/12% returns FV ₹50.46L (within expected ~₹50L), all 6 tabs switch (sip/daily/lumpsum/swp/goal/emi), Download PNG triggers file download (TFD-sip-calculator.png) and shows toast 'Snapshot downloaded — share it on WhatsApp!'. Mobile 390x844: tabs in single scrollable row, inputs below tabs, chart below inputs (no overlap), PNG+Start buttons in horizontal row, 3 metrics (Invested/Returns/FV) visible side-by-side.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking ai-chat-starter button in automated test did not produce captured response within 25s in one run, while typed custom message via ai-chat-input + ai-chat-send worked reliably. Likely a race condition between message-list re-render and starter button click handler (starters only render when messages.length === 1). User-facing impact: low — typing works; starter clicks may occasionally lose first click. Suggest debouncing or making starter render condition more permissive.

issues: Slight 4px horizontal overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth=394 vs clientWidth=390. Likely from FAB toggle (left-4) or scrollable tab strip. Cosmetic, not functional.

Recharts console warning: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart' — same warning flagged in iteration_1, still present. Non-blocking. Fix: gate ResponsiveContainer with minHeight or render after tab measures.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 334: dead expression `yield f"data: {ev.content}\n\n".replace(...) if False else _sse(ev.content)` — the ternary is always False, so left branch is unreachable. Simplify to `yield _sse(ev.content)`.

server.py /api/ai/chat: history is NOT rehydrated into the LlmChat instance — comments acknowledge this. Each session starts fresh per request, so multi-turn conversational memory currently relies on the emergentintegrations library's own per-session in-memory store (works within one worker process). On worker restart or scale-out, prior turns will be lost. Action: either pass prior history into system_message or accept this as a known limitation.
server.py: ai_sessions docs grow unbounded ($push messages array). No TTL or cap on conversation length. Action: consider $slice in $push or TTL index on ai_sessions.created_at for production.
server.py: AIChatRequest.message has max_length=2000 but no min after trim; '   ' would currently pass (whitespace-only). Consider validator.
server.py imports `from emergentintegrations.llm.chat import ...` inside the route — cold-start adds latency on first chat. Move to module-level import (with try/except logged once at startup).
FloatingActions.jsx: 'a' tags target=_blank without rel='noopener' — currently only rel='noreferrer' is set. Add 'noopener' for security.

AIChat.jsx: SSE reader uses fetch+ReadableStream; if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing the 500 response is consumed silently and only a generic 'Sorry...' error appears. Consider surfacing the actual error to console for debuggability.

AIChat.jsx Markdown component: `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` is used with renderInline output which sanitises &/</>, but bold/italic regex consume `**...**` greedily — multi-line bold could leak. Low risk for chat content but worth a note.

rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found. AI starter race is automation-timing only — the React state update right after first send() unmounts the starters div, so a follow-up click before re-render could miss. User clicks naturally have a longer gap so unlikely to hit in production. The 4px mobile overflow is cosmetic. The unreachable ternary in server.py:334 is a code-smell, not a bug (always falls through to _sse).
